dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple circular and semi-circular structures with high-contrast light-toned perimeters. Prominent O-shaped rings in the central dorsal region exhibit sharp edge transitions with darker centers that are lighter than the base fur tone.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid, high-intensity light pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily localized on the anterior-lateral region near the head and scattered along the lower ventral boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most prominent central-dorsal macro-annuli form an irregular quadrilateral. Three smaller annuli in the mid-lateral region form a compact acute triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive overlapping of macro-annuli perimeters in the mid-body section creating a complex, interlocking mesh-like texture.
